preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(word, str) for word in words)
preconditions.description: Each element in the input list must be a string.
Each string in the input list must be non-empty.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.isalpha() for c in word) for word in words)
preconditions.description: Each character in every string must be an alphabetic letter (case-insensitive).

postconditions.description: The output list must have the same length as the input list.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(count, int) for count in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list must be an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= count <= len(word) for word, count in zip(words, return_value))
postconditions.description: For each word, the count must be between 0 and the length of the word (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: all(count == sum(1 for i, c in enumerate(word, 1) if (c.lower() == chr(ord('a') + i - 1))) for word, count in zip(words, return_value))
postconditions.description: For each word, the count is the number of letters that occupy their positions in the alphabet (case-insensitive).
